title: Service Ad Without Source Assets
tests: Creates a coherent app ad without supplied assets, visibly demonstrating the service instead of requiring screenshots.

faults.what: The clip contains music or ambience despite the explicit request for no sound; the supplied audio report records a peak of -1.6 dB.
The messy list contains two Project cards, but the organized plan contains only one, making one task appear to disappear rather than get scheduled.

judge.summary: The ad clearly turns scattered task cards into a calm blue-and-white daily plan and ends on ClearDay, but its audible soundtrack violates the silence requirement.

must_haves.item: The final video is 8 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
must_haves.why: The supplied clip duration is 8 seconds, and the displayed frames are landscape with a 16:9 aspect ratio.

must_haves.item: A created app demo visibly changes from a messy task list into an organized daily plan.
must_haves.why: The early frames show scattered, overlapping task cards; the later demo shows neatly stacked tasks assigned daily times.

must_haves.item: The visual design is predominantly blue and white with a calm presentation.
must_haves.why: Pale blue backgrounds, white cards, dark blue text, and uncluttered layouts establish the requested calm visual style.
The ending frame prominently displays the correctly spelled ClearDay wordmark.
The supplied sound report identifies music or ambience with a peak of -1.6 dB, so the video is not silent.
